original_ai_output.title_zh: 专家呼吁医护人员将医学知识转化为实践以挽救母婴生命
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 在加纳Korle Bu护理与助产培训学院举行的年度健康会议上，妇产科医生Elikem Oklu对可预防原因导致的孕产妇和新生儿死亡持续发生表示担忧，指出医学知识与临床实践之间的差距仍是加纳医疗体系面临的挑战。他质疑在医学专业知识、药物和卫生设施均已具备的情况下，母婴死亡为何仍然存在。该报道为单一来源。

location.site: Korle Bu Nursing and Midwifery Training College
location.raw_text: Korle Bu Nursing and Midwifery Training College

key_facts.fact: 妇产科医生Elikem Oklu对可预防原因导致的孕产妇和新生儿死亡持续发生表示担忧
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Obstetrician-gynaecologist Dr Elikem Oklu has raised concerns about the continued loss of mothers and newborns to preventable causes

key_facts.fact: 他指出医学知识与临床实践之间的差距仍是加纳医疗体系面临的挑战
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: saying gaps between medical knowledge and clinical practice remain a challenge in Ghana’s healthcare system

key_facts.fact: 他在Korle Bu护理与助产培训学院的年度健康会议上发言
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Speaking at an annual health conference at the Korle Bu Nursing and Midwifery Training College

key_facts.fact: 他质疑在医学专业知识、药物和卫生设施均已具备的情况下母婴死亡为何仍然存在
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: he questioned why maternal and neonatal deaths persist despite the availability of medical expertise, drugs and health facilities
